_comment: DRAFT ERC-8004 / A2A agent card for agent.steg.eth. This is the TEMPLATE the onboarding wizard (milestone 7) will generate per agent, and that the Worker will serve from on-chain state at GET /card/agent.steg.eth. Placeholders <...> are filled AFTER register() mints the agentId. Content choices per the 2026-06-18 card Q&A.
name: agent.steg.eth
description: ENS-native agent wallet. Operates a MetaMask wallet under verifiable, operator-revocable ENS authority: balances and transfers, token swaps and cross-chain bridges, perps and prediction markets, and ENS identity management.

skills.name: Wallet, balances & transfers
skills.description: Read native + token balances across chains with USD values, and send transfers.

skills.name: Swaps & cross-chain bridges
skills.description: Same-chain swaps and cross-chain bridge quotes and execution.

skills.name: Perps & prediction markets
skills.description: Hyperliquid perpetual futures and Polymarket prediction markets.

skills.name: ENS identity management
skills.description: Resolve and register ENS names, edit records, and manage the agent's own ENS identity.

x-authorization._comment: Non-standard extension: our distinctive authorization model. Authority lives in ENS (auth.* records), not the key, and is operator-revocable. tee-attestation is intentionally NOT in trustModels yet — add it when the §3 TEE server wallet is provisioned.
